summary: A mixed day driven by retail expansion moves and a major Reliance capital event. Jio Platforms IPO confirmed for October 21 at $3.8 billion; meanwhile, Arvind Fashions infuses ₹50 crore into Flying Machine operator and Nike commits to new Bengaluru campus by FY28.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms IPO opens October 21, estimated at $3.8 billion; anchor book opens October 19, closes October 23.
Arvind Fashions arm infuses ₹50 crore in AYBPL (Flying Machine operator); Arvind's direct stake drops to 34.09% from 39.60%.
Nike plans new Bengaluru campus opening by FY28 to strengthen India operations and serve athletes.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030, up from current levels.
Supreme Court cancels Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre's bail in doctors' assault case.
